[quote=qianxun;60364307][b]The Kuwalkti Incident[/b]

The situation in Democratic Astanir was rapidly improving by the second. With the southern exclave rescued, the Democratic lines have been effectively stablilized save for a tiny pocket of isolationist forces still in the midst of an encirclement by Pax Int'l and Democratic troops. However, while externally the Democratic movement seemed to be on the cusp of reforming itself into a major player, internally things were in crisis. General Haru Arono, the iconic figurehead of Democratic forces, had accepted peace talks in Teremok and had left the fighting behind to attend as the representative of his side in the conflict.

His departure would precipitate worries within Pax Int'l's Board of Directors, which up to this point have expressed continued confidence in Gen. Arono's ability to prosecute war on behalf of the Democratic movement. Now though, things would be placed into jeopardy, with Qianxun fearful that the Democratic movement may be prematurely disarmed before its agents could adequately plant the seeds of socialist revolution. Furthermore, mounting losses and defections despite military successes meant that now, more than ever, Democratic Astanir now truly and wholly relied upon the Qianxun and Elseyro-Vespurians to ensure its own survival.

[list]

[u]13 JAN 2026. 10:03 PM[/u]

David Cyriacus, head of Pax International, was seen departing from Kuwalkti with his staff along with a few elements of the Democratic Army. Freya Moran, his second-in-command, was allegedly also seen in his entourage despite serving as the [i]de facto[/i] head of all active forces in the Democratic frontlines. Cyriacus appeared agitated when asked for questions by the press. In a prepared statement, he stressed that the Democratic movement "shall be preserved at any cost" while negotiations were being held in Teremok, with Pax International remaining committed to saving the weak and poor of Astaniran society necessary.

[u]13 JAN 2026. 10:20 PM[/u]

Freya Moran is seen with a large unit of Astaniran troops. Quite unusually, these soldiers wore turquoise armbands and were all uniformly equipped in modernized Qianxun assault rifles. Moran declined to comment on the purpose of these forces, but an off-hand remark recorded that she required "all means for victory". Around this same time, conventional police forces surrounding Kuwalkti disappear, replaced by military inspectors and Pax Int'l security officers.

[u]13 JAN 2026. 11:09 PM[/u]

Pax Int'l unloads an additional 25,000 employees onto Democratic Astanir, bringing its total available forces to around 100,000 men. However, this final 25,000 men are not immediately seen anywhere in Democratic Astanir, neither visible distributing aid nor fighting on the frontlines.

[u]13 JAN 2026. 11:15 PM[/u]

Three ZTZ-91 Qiongqi tanks appear at Kuwalkti air base together with 30 PLZ-93 Sledgehammer assault guns. Cyriacus and all other Pax Int'l staff are seen among the armored crews, claiming that the resources were to support the Democratic war effort.

[u]14 JAN 2026. 12:45 AM[/u]

All three Qiongqi tanks take aim at Kuwalkti air base. An Astaniran infantry regiment of around 3,000 wearing turquoise armbands storm the air base while Pax Int'l security officers disarm Democratic units meant to protect the base. The men call themselves members of the "Committee of Executives of the Democratic Council" (CEDC), and was operating under a "popular mandate" to supplant the executive powers of the Democratic Council.

CEDC forces arrest the following men:

[list]

The Acting Commander-in-Chief of the Democratic Army

Chief of Staff of the Democratic Army

Commander of the Democratic Navy

Chief of Intelligence

Colonel of Police

Chief Justice of the Democratic Judiciary

All sitting members of the Democratic Council

All heads of the provisional parties waiting for representation in the Democratic movement

[/list]

While this was ongoing, all Democratic aid workers within Democratic territory would be ordered to take a five-day, fully paid leave from work, with all aid stations and medical checkpoints replaced completely by Qianxun and Elseyro-Vespurian workers to prevent strikes from cutting the flow of resources to Astanir's populace. Those refusing to take paid leave are directed to instead work in the Pax Int'l field hospitals, while those rejecting even this would be kidnapped and placed into vans toward an unknown fate.

[u]14 JAN 2026. 1:00 AM[/u]

The CEDC "launches a formal investigation" into corruption concerning members of the detained Democratic Council. A few seconds later, martial law is declared in Democratic Astanir, a mere formality, given that the state was already in martial law under the Arono government, with the CEDC merely supplanting the order to affirm its own executive power.

[u]14 JAN 2026. 5:07 AM[/u]

After four hours, during which time the CEDC conducted house-to-house arrests of suspected dissidents against the takeover, a circular is distributed by all printing offices controlled by Pax International urging citizens to resume their duties for the day, while the CEDC began to slowly but surely take over the mid-level and low-level jobs in its government structure.

The composition of the CEDC would be initially amorphous, with most of its attending officers explicitly identifying themselves, claming the neccessity for confidentiality in the face of the "fascist military onslaught". However, after "pressure" from Pax International who sought to "identify the leaders it must coordinate with to continue the flow of aid", the CEDC would agree to release a redacted list of its intended cabinet structure:

[list]

[b]Committee of Executives of the Democratic Council[/b]

Horano Benir, [i]Chairman of the CEDC[/i]

David Cyriacus, [i]Vice-Chairman of the CEDC and Minister of the Interior[/i]

Freya Moran, [i]Minister of War[/i]

Rokan Gilon, [i]Minister of Foreign Affairs[/i]

Soli Karil, [i]Minister of Justice[/i]

Qiu Guang, [i]Minister of Education[/i]

Han Shihong, [i]Minister of Labor[/i]

XXXXXX, [i]Minister of Agriculture and Irrigation[/i]

Joral Sjola, [i]Minister of Health[/i]

Tarak Vali, [i]Minister of Public Works[/i]

XXXXXX, [i]Minister of Trade and Industry[/i]

XXXXXX, [i]Minister of Supplies[/i]

XXXXXX, [i]Minister of Finance[/i]

Liang Zi, [i]Commissioner-general on Land Use[/i]

Qi Pengfei, [i]Commissioner-general on Information, Telecommunications, and E-government[/i]

XXXXXX, [i]Commissioner-general on Elections[/i]

Yun Caibo, [i]Commissioner-general on Civil Defense[/i]

[/list]

The Democratic Council as an institution would not be dissolved outright, though the extralegal offices created by the CEDC would effectively supplant all of its powers, making the Council an irrelevant but still technically-extant body.

According to the CEDC document, its cabinet was to be a technocratic body, mandated to "build ground" for the preparation of a "social, democratic, and popular republic". The document listed twelve ministerial bodies and four, cabinet-level commissions that was to act as the highest organ of Democratic power while in the midst of civil war. Pax International, which had effectively formed its own parallel government to the Democratic movement thanks to its aid and military backing, would be absorbed into the CEDC, fielding its own corporate officers to serve in the Democratic government.

Expecting some backlash, pro-CEDC forces would begin hourly patrols in the Democratic cities to "protect its new and modernizing government", and would pay off the most destitute members of Democratic Astanir to publicly receive food and medicine from CEDC-controlled aid stations, while others would be encouraged to form rallies and marches to mobilize public support for the new regime. At the same time, posters and pamphlets would be distributed justifying the government takeover, with the CEDC claiming that Haru Arono's decision to depart for Teremok constitutes dereliction of duty and the abandonment of the Democratic cause for short-term gains.

Horano Benir, a certified machinist and manager of the Pax Int'l aid station near Kuwalkti, would be chosen by both CEDC and Pax Int'l to head the new government. Though, most actual decision-making would fall in the hands of Pax Int'l itself. The Commission on Elections, one of the cabinet-level commissions in the new government, would be ordered to take over Haru Arono's work of setting up a new constitution and multi-party democracy, though under its strict supervision. The Commissioner-general on Elections, an unidentified CEDC officer, would be placed in charge of the first drafts.

The coup would be dubbed the "Kuwalkti incident" by the media, though the exact sequence of events would be swiftly suppressed by the CEDC before they could be circulated to the public.

[u]17 JAN 2026. 10:09 AM[/u]

The CEDC declares the creation of three political parties to be represented in a future national legislature: The Astaniran Social Party (ASP), the Astaniran National Party (ANP), and the Liberal Union (LU). 

The Astaniran Social Party would be staffed primarily by technical experts and community leaders recruited by the Qianxun Socialist Ethics Commission together with native Astaniran officers who participated in the Kuwalkti incident. While nominally social democratic, Qianxun and Pax Int'l hopes to use the ASP as a political vehicle to reorient the Astaniran public towards left-wing politics. Horano Benir, CEDC Chairman, would be appointed by Pax Int'l to serve as ASP party leader, making ASP the [i]de facto[/i] governing party.

The Astaniran National Party and the Liberal Union, both officially centrist parties, would result from the forced mergers of the various preexisting political parties seeking legal recognition within the Democratic Council, with their leaders coerced into signing memoranda affirming their loyalty to the CEDC and the ASP in exchange for permission to operate under those two political parties. Branch offices for the ANP and the LL would be set up by Pax Int'l, ostensibly to draw in support, but in actuality to monitor Astanirans seeking to protest ASP's formation by joining these two parties.

Around this same time, a new government department is created by the Commission on Elections, granting Astanirans an avenue to found their own political parties. However, its staff would be constituted by members of the Qianxun Socialist Ethics Commission, who would keep track of applicants and shred their application forms and political theses.

---

[/list]

David Cyriacus, through Horano Benir, would now be the [i]de facto[/i] shadow dictator of Democratic Astanir. All power was now concentrated in him through a series of puppet offices and front organizations, through Pax Int'l, the CEDC, and ASP. With overarching military strategy now entirely in his hands, he would order Freya Moran to stabilize the western frontlines against pro-junta forces and "concentrate all available power" into a decisive, southern push to cut the isolationist territory neatly in two.

Wuying-89 jets are scrambled from Kuwalkti to eliminate isolationist air bases and destroy unused aircraft, while Pax Int'l and CEDC troops began their offensives, now directly commanded by Qianxun and Elseyro-Vespurian military officers.[/quote]

The takeover would come as a surprise to most Astanirans living in Democratic territory. They had placed their trust, their entire lives in the hands of Pax international, and now they do this, a seemingly unprovoked attack on their fellow democrats. However, generally the people of the Democratic territory would not protest nor give much attention to the political situation, they would simply be grateful for the aid that pax international had given them.

Many soldiers of the Democratic army would be assimilated into the ranks of pax international and Qianxun, not daring to speak out against them. Those that defected would travel north as fast as possible to form a fortified enclave where they could regroup and decide a course of action.

With Haru in Teremok and the Democratic council arrested, leadership would be disputed. The defected democratically would become fragmented, some opting to form a new movement, some pushing to retake the Democratic army and some stating that their best option would be to flee the country entirely.

This fragmentation would provide a perfect target for the other factions, a vulnerable enclave which could be surrounded and conquered with ease.

Meanwhile, the isolationist national forces, who still held Astan and the majority of the islands territory would use this severe slip up from the democrats as propaganda. They would use this to show the consequences of putting trust in foreigners and leftist ideologies. The people inside their territory would be slowly brainwashed, further solidifying their control over the country.

Haru, now landed in Teremok and preparing to meet with the other leaders, would not be made aware of the situation until 4 days afterwards. The newly founded enclave would require powerful radio equipment to be set up, which would take a while. Once informed, Haru would be sure to take this into the negotiations.

[quote=astanir;60374238]The increased aid from the Nordiheimians may prove to be short-lived. Whilst all of the three tribes accept the help gratefully, negotiations would begin to stagnate. Issues over influence and control of the three tribes along with historical issues and borders that couldn't be resolved would lead all three tribes to walk out of negotiations.

The help to the Sulwik-Et-Hamanar would allow them to organise a total takeover of their islands. Additionally, word would spread from the island and soon another revolt would be well underway on the other lower islands, courtesy of the tribes of Skui.

Nordiheimian intelligence would most likely show an abundance of military resources present on the islands, likely a storage facility and ports used to send intelligence and equipment to the frontlines from afar.

Operation sky serpent would be a roaring success for the most part. Nordiheimian aid would stabilise positions on the frontline, as well as bringing the Sui-mana tribe into the fight.[/quote]

[b][u]The issue of the 3 tribes[/u][/b]
While support to the 3 tribes in the north-western part of Astanir would not stop their inability to work trough their differences and old grudges would be cause for concern, if they could not manage to work as a unified front then their strugle for freedom or atleast a bether tomorrow would only meat defeat ageinst their larger oponents.
As such two tings would need to be done:
*Find out as much as possible about their past grievances and points of disagreements
*And find a compromice they could all agree on.
They would also update them on the wider situation;

They would first be told about the good tings such as their Argossian brethren on the two lower islands was successfully rising up to claiming their freedom, and how the central enclave of the Sui-mana tribe were finaly reciving aid to be able to fight more propperly.

But they would then be struck with the bad news;
>How the Armed Restoration Front had a major stronghold on the large south-western island were they still had plenty of supplies and strenght that could be sendt to bolster their strenght on mainland Astanir ones more.
>The increasing controll and will to fight that the Astaniran National Forces was showing despite their battles.
>The supricing but effective attack on the Amaralo People's Army by the large nation of Pantagruel, wich not only left this faction under the controll of this large nation but also showed how far and with how much force they were potentialy ready and willing to go into Astanir with.
>And of corse the fact that the Democratic Army of Astanir had not only been taken over be another outside force, the Qianxun, but they had been reciving large amount of support and even troops to fight for their cause.

The Nordiheimians would emphatize with greate care the fact that the Argossian tribes would stand absolutely no chance to achive their freedom and goals if they could not find some way to look past their differences and work out a compromize that they could live with in an effort to work together as one force.

[b][u]The lower islands:[/u][/b]
When the tribes of Skui started their revolt on the secound island the Nordiheimians would use their agents on the island to direct and help the tribes to take a port so that propper amounts of weapons and supplies could be delivered to them.
Ones more the Nordiheimians would try to use the delivery of Iron Drake 2D tanks to bolster the Argossians with firepower that the local Armed Restoration Front forces would be hard pressed to deal with.
In addition a small attachment of Nordiheim navy vesels would be sendt to effectivly cut the small islands of from possible support.

[b][u]The Sui-mana:[/u][/b]
With the success of operation Sky Serpent efforts would be made to see if heavier weapons and light vehicles could be air dropped to them, this would start with weapons such as the 105mm artillery piece and larger mortar launchers together with amunition aswell as some lighter variants of the Kangaroo MAMIV to see how able the Sui-mana was at reciving and using them.
Nordiheim would have to wait for messages from their agents to find out how successfull it would be.

The agents in the sorounding lands controlled by the Astaniran National Forces would continue to look out for potential treaths to the large planes doing the air drops and communicate and new information they might gather, tough since the National forces now knew that someone was hidding there they would have to be more carefull about it and use some of their efforts on countering and dealing with atempts that might be done to find and stopping them.

[u][b]The large Astanir island joust south-east of Italian dutch:[/b][/u]
While the agents that had been dispatched there would continue their operatons of information gathering and infiltration the discovery that the Armed Restoration Front had such a stronghold there would have to be dealt with somehow.
As such a dedicated COMINT (Communications Intelligence) ship based in Ostland would be sendt to take up possition between the large island and Astanir itself to help intercept and listen inn on the cominications of the Armed Restoration Front, it would also try to listen inn on the Astaniran National Forces when they could.
It would be given a small dedicated navy escort to protect it, including Nordiheims 2 Sleipnir-Class Frigates incase the Restoration Front had any submarines up their sleeve.
